reasons: Section 9.4 as quoted meets the T4C preferred position on all material terms: Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form on 30 days' written notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, no early-termination fee, and express denial of any Vendor convenience right during a committed term.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph and no counterparty comment was proposed, so nothing is being over-flagged or mis-edited.
The deterministic check confirms a Customer convenience-termination right is present, corroborating the classification.
The rationale correctly declines to double-flag the Section 2.1 take-or-pay tension under T4C, deferring it to the minimum-commitment rule as the playbook's no-double-flagging convention requires.
